Russia’s Permanent Representative to the UN Geneva office and other Geneva-based international organizations Gennady Gatilov has called for taking into account African countries’ shared position on reforming the UN Security Council. “Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and his African counterparts have agreed to tighten coordination within the United Nations and other international organizations, including in the context of the UN Security Council reform, which should take into account Africa’s common stance,” he said at a reception at Russia’s mission in Geneva on the occasion of the 3rd Russia-Africa summit on October 28-29. Russia and African countries “share similar views on the most pressing international issues,” he said, adding that these include the situation surrounding Iran, the Middle East peace process, the politicization of the International Criminal Court (ICC), and armed conflicts on the African continent.

🇺🇸 🇮🇱 🇮🇷 ⚡️ — President Trump is considering another major round of military strikes against Iran, with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushing for a joint U.S.-Israeli air campaign lasting four to seven days, according to NYT, citing U.S. and Israeli officials. Trump has not made a decision but is weighing Israeli intelligence warnings that Iran is rebuilding its missile and drone arsenals and advancing chemical and biological weapons programs, alongside the significant U.S. military firepower currently deployed in the region. The proposal has divided Trump administration officials over the intelligence's reliability and the risks of renewed attacks. Netanyahu, facing political uncertainty after last month's Israeli elections, favors swift action.
